title: Exact Limiting Minimax ATE Risk in a Balanced Known-Channel Collision Benchmark
banked_reason: D0.5.G tier=incremental < floor=field (target=field) and NOT salvageable in scope; mathematically sound exact minimax result confined to a calibrated sequence, paper_score_ceiling 6.3 < 7.4.
gap_reasons: The advertised exact minimax limit is delivered: uniform original-record attainment and the balanced-prior full-likelihood lower converge to the evaluated constant, without assuming global experiment equivalence. Its scientific reach is confined to one calibrated sequence with known uniform design, exact balance, public cellwise moments, and specified coding reliability. The limiting risk improves on the optimal constant action by approximately 0.78%, and the package supplies neither a quantitative finite-sample accuracy guarantee nor a treatment-review allocation result. The inspected [Zeng theorem](https://arxiv.org/html/2405.00118v3) and [Hou–Mukherjee–Cai theorem](https://www.jmlr.org/papers/volume26/23-1587/23-1587.pdf) concern different experiments, but separation from those comparators does not establish a broadly useful inference framework. These substantive scope and practical-relevance limits constrain the projected leading-econometrics score even after competent rewriting; no stale matched-risk overclaim or unresolved model-specific proof premise warrants a further downgrade. [D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 6.3 < 7.4, so the graded tier 'field' is capped at 'incremental'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]

The main exact-risk theorem gives an evaluable original-record minimax deliverable, but its positioning does not compare it with the closest accepted-bank discrete/semisupervised ATE frontiers (in particular stat_semisupervised_discrete_ate_annotation_frontier and stat_discrete_ate_heterogeneity_frontier), so its theorem-level novelty over in-repository accepted work is not yet established.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery derived the exact limiting causal minimax risk, a total original-record attaining rule, and a balanced-prior full-record lower bound; the mathematical panel passed after five source attestations. The result remained incremental at the field novelty floor because its calibrated model has limited scientific reach and no quantitative finite-sample or treatment-review allocation theorem. Formalization was not entered; the accepted-bank comparator omission remains a disclosed positioning issue, and the sound kernel may be re-anchored at a corrected tier.
tldr: The supplied-moment balanced benchmark has an exact positive limiting all-estimator ATE MSE: \(R_\star=e^{-1/256}\mathbb E[\operatorname{sech}(Z/(8\sqrt2))]/576\), approximately \(0.0017226523544\). A total rational-output rule computed from original-record collisions attains it uniformly over the identical class. A legal exactly balanced permutation prior gives the matching lower from the full marked likelihood, including clean outcomes and different-cell dependence. The Gaussian decision is evaluated analytically; the whole-class original-record risk limit is the contribution.
gap: Zeng et al. bound causal risk with discrete adjustment; Hou--Mukherjee--Cai establish annotated-surrogate efficiency. Neither inspected result evaluates this balanced known-channel critical original-record risk.
fill: The complete result derives a computable positive limiting MSE with uniform original-record attainment and a legal full-record lower. The value and optimizer are derived outputs.
